format_text.cp_ch2: cp_ch2: code_pointer_v1's CH2 programs (data/code_pointer_v1/main/{animals,months}_CH2_e5f0.json, 400 scenes each): a dict line `lockers = {...}` of 5 keys, then a 2-variable target chain (x = "mouse"; h = x) and a distractor chain, then print(lockers[h]); suite_v1's chat prompt ('What does this Python code print?'). The bridge word = the target chain's head key; S = the item's dissoc source (another key heads the chain, its own dict). One reader (the lookup): the monitor's (d) is the key's recalled number (legs / month), read at the bridge word and at the lookup's last token (CH2 has no recall prompt; the recall slot repeats the lookup's prompt); the dict always precedes the chain, so the probe has no locker-after stratum
